title: Cortex VerificationEvidence (DRAFT v0)
description: Grader output for a completed task. Captures structured grading results including individual check results and evidence artifacts. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer.

receipt_id.description: Reference to the ExecutionReceipt being graded.

description.description: Human-readable description of what was checked.

status.description: The status of this individual check.

details.description: Optional details or explanation of the result.

reference.description: Reference to the artifact (URL, path, or identifier).

artifacts.description: Evidence artifacts supporting the grading decision.

grader.description: Identity of the grader (agent or system).

graded_at.description: When the grading was completed (ISO-8601 UTC).
